plain_description: **Build speech and conversational AI features for your products.** Use ready-made recipes and pretrained models for transcription, speech generation, speaker recognition, and other audio and text tasks. Train models from scratch or fine-tune existing ones.
technical_description: SpeechBrain is an open-source PyTorch toolkit for conversational AI, speech, and text processing. It provides training recipes across more than 20 tasks, pretrained models with inference interfaces, and support for training from scratch or fine-tuning pretrained models. It also supports GPU and distributed training, Hugging Face integration, and YAML-based hyperparameter management.
title: SpeechBrain
